profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at UnitedHealth Group
profile.summary:
o	Hands on knowledge in popular programming languages such as Java, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, 
  	Apache Camel
o	Experience in Agile/Scrum software development
o	Proficient in designing and developing REST web services using Apache camel and Java
o	Familiar in working with angular for developing various UI components and integrating with backend   services
o      Led Scrum team for 3 Program Increments
o	Developed debugging skills and participated in multiple code reviews
o	Participated in multiple UAT releases, Production releases and Production support activities

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Experience in Agile/Scrum software development
• Experience in leading a scrum team for 3 PIs
• Embraced Microservices Architecture and extended into software products and delivery processes
• Designed and implemented several REST web services using Apache Camel and Java
• Built Error Handling Component for managing business error messages more efficiently
• Implemented validation rules using Drools, a Business Rules Management System built by RedHat
• Built transaction tracking capabilities for micro-service architecture by utilizing secure random api
• Designed and implemented automation test suite for web service functional testing
• Implemented several UI components for the providers’ portal using Angular JS
• Participated in multiple UAT releases, Production releases and Production support activities
• Developed debugging skills and participated in multiple code reviews

positions.title: TDP Summer Intern
positions.description:
• Built login and registration system for an android application.
• Utilized new technologies such as Spring MVC, RESTful APIs for building web-services

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description:
• Designed and graded homework assignments and recorded on the class’ webpage
• Observed students’ performance and assisted in designing exams and quizzes for the class
• Taught class on professor’s absence

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
• Provided excellent customer service
• Inventory Management, Leadership visibility, Training new hires, and bringing them up to the speed
